steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each leaver task is placed against the leaving date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Access still active after the leaving date
findings.fix: Remove the access now and log it

findings.title: Final pay step with no due date
findings.fix: Set the due date for the final pay

outcome.notChecked: Whether access was removed in every system.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] access-removal.md:12  Access still active after the leaving date.

[medium] final-pay.md:19  Final pay step with no due date.

pros: Checks a leaver with access still active after the leaving date, and a final pay step with no due date.
cons: Not checked: Whether access was removed in every system.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hr-offboarding-exit skill on the records for this review.
